title: Live Nation reveals plans for South America’s largest indoor arena in São Paulo
summary: Live Nation has announced plans to develop Brazil’s first purpose-built music venue, the 21,000-capacity São Paulo Arena, which will reportedly become the largest indoor arena for live entertainment in South America. The São Paulo Arena will be located within the Cidade Center Norte district, Brazil’s most comprehensive planned urban living neighbourhood. title: ‘Different languages’: SE Asia stadium touring hampered by public-private ‘misalignment’
summary: South-East Asian cities are losing out on international stadium tours as promoters fail to frame concerts “in public value terms” for governments, according to a leading events executive in the region. So says Jin Teik Oon, managing director of the disrupTEIK Consultancy and former CEO of The Kallang complex which houses Singapore’s National Stadium, who tells IQ that “different languages” spoken by governments and promoters have resulted in a regional booking landscape where “tours can swing away from a market overnight”. title: Record 233 million tune in to Tomorrowland livestreams
summary: Global viewership for Tomorrowland swelled by over 20% for the Belgian electronic festival’s 2026 edition, raising the bar to a record 233 million views across digital livestreams, demonstrating the value of democratising access for international festival brands.
